create_LSTMTrainer: create an LSTMTrainer instance with verbose logging for reinforcement learning training
setup_LSTMTrainer: setup the LSTMTrainer with an RL method, model interface, and sampler
run_actor_loop: run the actor method to sample actions from the current model state
